test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_{partitions} (a UInt64, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY a PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % {partitions}
CREATE TABLE test_unsorted_{partitions} (a UInt64, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % {partitions}
CREATE TABLE t_skew90_uniq_{partitions} (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY if(sipHash64(a) % 10 < 9, 0, 1 + sipHash64(a) % 15)
CREATE TABLE t_skew30_dup_{partitions} (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY if(sipHash64(a) % 10 < 3, 0, 1 + sipHash64(a) % 15)
